turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, can I get a medium latte?
turns.ko: 안녕하세요, 미디엄 라떼 한 잔 주세요.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure. For here or to go?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: To go, please. I'd like it less sweet.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: No problem. Anything else?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Excuse me, how do I get to City Hall?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Go straight for two blocks and turn left.
turns.ko: 두 블록 직진한 뒤 왼쪽으로 도세요.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Is it far from here?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Not really. It's on your right next to the bank.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Can we move our meeting to tomorrow?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure. Did something come up?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Yes, I need more time to finish the report.
turns.ko: 네, 보고서를 마무리할 시간이 더 필요해요.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: No problem. Does 10 a.m. work for you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hello, this is Mina from ABC Company.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Hi, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat your name?
turns.ko: 안녕하세요, 잘 못 들었어요. 이름을 다시 말씀해주실래요?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Sure, it's Mina. I called about your order.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Thanks. Could you speak a little slower, please?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, I'd like to return this shirt.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure. Do you have the receipt?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Yes, here it is. The size doesn't fit me.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I understand. Would you like an exchange or a refund?

dialogues.title: Making a Doctor Appointment
key_patterns: I'd like to make an appointment

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Kim.
turns.ko: 안녕하세요, 김 선생님 진료 예약하고 싶어요.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure. Are there any days that work better for you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Do you have any openings this Friday?
turns.ko: 이번 주 금요일에 빈 시간이 있나요?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yes, 3 p.m. is available.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: How's the project going so far?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'm almost done with the first draft.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Great. Could you send it by noon?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure, I'll get back to you before lunch.

dialogues.title: Restaurant Reservation
key_patterns: I'd like to make a reservation

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hello, I'd like to make a reservation for tonight.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Of course. For how many people?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: For two people at 7 p.m., please.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Done. We look forward to seeing you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, I have a reservation under Park.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Welcome. Could I see your ID, please?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Sure. Is breakfast included?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yes, and check-out is at 11 a.m.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, I'm interested in joining this gym.
turns.ko: 안녕하세요, 이 헬스장 등록에 관심 있어요.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Great. How often do you plan to come?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: About three times a week. How much is the monthly plan?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: It's 50 dollars, and we offer a one-day trial.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Can you hear me now?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yes, but your screen is frozen.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Thanks for letting me know. I'll reconnect.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: No worries. You're back now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Do you want to grab lunch this weekend?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure. How about Saturday?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Saturday works for me. Around 1 p.m.?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Perfect. Let's do that.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Do you have an iPhone charger by any chance?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yes, I do. Do you need it now?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Could I borrow it for 20 minutes?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Of course. Just leave it on my desk later.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I'm interested in this bag. Is this your best price?
turns.ko: 이 가방 관심 있는데요. 이게 최저가인가요?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I can give you a small discount.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Could you lower it to 40 dollars?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I can do 45. Deal?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I reviewed your presentation. I like the structure.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Thanks. Any suggestions for improvement?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Could you add one real example on slide three?
turns.ko: 3번 슬라이드에 실제 예시 하나 추가해줄 수 있을까요?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure, that makes sense. I'll update it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, I have a problem with my account login.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'm sorry to hear that. When did it start?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Since this morning. I reset my password, but it failed.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Please clear your browser cache and try again.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Good morning. How was your commute today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: It took longer than usual because of traffic.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Same here. It took me almost an hour.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Hopefully tomorrow will be better.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, did you receive the package I sent?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Not yet. It hasn't arrived yet.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I see. I'll check the tracking number now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Thanks for checking. Please let me know.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Could I have one more day for this task?
turns.ko: 이 업무 하루만 더 시간 받을 수 있을까요?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Maybe. Why do you need more time?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I found a data issue and need to fix it first.
turns.ko: 데이터 이슈를 발견해서 먼저 수정해야 해요.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Okay. Please send the final version by 5 p.m. tomorrow.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, I'm Jisoo. Nice to meet you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Nice to meet you too. What do you do?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I work in marketing at a startup.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: That's great. Let's keep in touch.
